title: Spiced Pear, Buckwheat and Almond Pancakes
changes_from_base: Blended buckwheat groats and almond flour replace the wheat flour, grated pear and maple syrup sweeten a spiced batter lightened with whipped egg whites, and the stack is topped with caramelised pears and almonds.
summary: Nutty buckwheat and almond pancakes warmed through with cinnamon, ginger and cardamom, finished with caramelised pear wedges and toasted almonds.
equipment: nonstick frying pan (30 cm) or griddle
wire rack set in a rimmed baking tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
maple syrup, plus more to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Heat the oven to 93°C and set the wire rack in its tray.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 165 g buckwheat groats on high speed until as fine as possible, about 1 min, then whisk into a bowl with 113 g almond flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1½ tsp fine salt, 1 tsp cinnamon, ¾ tsp ginger and ½ tsp cardamom.

steps.title: Grate
steps.text: Grate the peeled pear into a bowl to make about 180 ml, whisk in the 2 egg yolks, 160 ml milk, 60 ml maple syrup and 2 tsp vanilla, then stir this into the dry mix.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk the 2 egg whites by hand until airy with very soft peaks, about 1 min, and fold them into the batter until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Melt 7 g butter in a 30 cm non-stick pan over medium heat, test with 1 tbsp batter, then cook 3 pancakes of 60 ml batter, spreading to 8 cm, until bubbles form, the edges set and the base turns golden, about 2 min, flipping to cook a further 2 min.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Keep the pancakes warm on the rack in the oven, wipe the pan and cook the rest of the batter in 3 more batches, using 7 g butter each time.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: Peel, core and cut the 2 topping pears into 2 cm wedges, then cook them in the wiped pan with 28 g butter, 2 tbsp maple syrup and ⅛ tsp salt over medium-high heat until melted and the pears are lightly caramelised on both cut sides, 3-4 min.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top the pancakes with the caramelised pears, 45 g toasted flaked almonds and extra maple syrup, and serve at once.

tips: Blend the buckwheat groats as finely as possible so the pancakes hold together well.
Fold the whisked egg whites in gently to keep the pancakes light.
Check that your baking powder is labelled gluten-free if this dish needs to stay free from wheat.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
